definition.label: Reliability-weighted spectral residual with frozen V25 correction
definition.error_basis: Protect unsupported/thin transaction histories by multiplying only the new residual by observed spectral support and n90/(n90+10); V25 coefficients remain fixed

definition.label: Fixed equal average of V167 spectral and V146 tree-complemented V25
definition.error_basis: V167 pooledKS0.530795 and V146 0.530528 reflect different source representations; combine without supervised weight fitting; original V25 remains an explicit component through V146
definition.formula: p=.5*p_V167+.5*p_V146; fixed matched-fold score averaging; no fitted meta weights

definition.label: 64-landmark Nystrom RBF residual on existing V25 domain features
definition.error_basis: Pairwise polynomial/FM additions were negative; test bounded smooth local interactions with a low-rank kernel and strong teacher tether, without changing Kumo context inputs

definition.label: Strongly regularized shallow LightGBM residual on fixed V25 logits
definition.error_basis: Standalone tree experts are weaker but offer some complementarity; fit only a small additive logit correction, rather than replacing Kumo or fitting a large full-risk model
definition.formula: eta=eta_V25+.15*clip(tree_raw_margin,-.5,.5);80 depth2 LightGBM trees trained with init_score=eta_V25
